findings.detail: Skills-Master-Database and Skills-Complete-Database point to the canonical Skills-All explorer. Category-member counts are explicitly source-category snapshots and are not treated as a unique current skill total.
Characters.md points to Characters-All and reports the live 152-identity baseline; its generic Search reference remains intentional full-text site search rather than a canonical entity explorer.
Mentors.md points to Mentors-All and preserves its separate official-source mentor count without conflating it with the smaller repository record layer.
Awoken-Skills.md points to Awoken-All and Skills-All/Characters-All for related navigation; no stale explorer destination was found.
DLC-Overview uses Characters-All and Parallel-Quests-All for canonical entity navigation and exposes the existing canonical database navigation block.

findings.surface: Super Soul / QQ Bang / Expert Mission references
findings.detail: No dedicated Super Soul, QQ Bang, or Expert Mission explorer replacement was invented. Existing pages remain landing/reference surfaces; canonical targets are used where dedicated explorers exist.

evidence_boundary: Navigation and current-reference consistency only. This scan does not establish new skill, character, mentor, Awoken, DLC, Super Soul, QQ Bang, or Expert Mission relationships, acquisition conditions, probabilities, mechanics, or completeness.
